title: The last ordinary week, v
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Friday. Christmas. Gully's dock, the family, the pup, the chair. Wood on the steps. The same as every year, which is the point, which the strip does not say.

panels.composition: The dock, Christmas, gray day, string lights on anyway. GULLY, MARIA in the chair, the kids — ten and seven — on the dock. WOOD on the steps. BARNABY II.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a dock on a gray Christmas day with string lights on, a family with two children, a woman in an old lawn chair, a thin man on shack steps and a small three-legged dog

panels.composition: The girl, ten, showing Wood a drawing: a crab, eight legs, better than his. He looks at it a long time.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a ten-year-old girl showing a thin man a drawing of a crab which he studies for a long moment

panels.composition: Gully with two coffees. Handing one down to the steps. The minute.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man handing a coffee down to a thin man sitting on shack steps

panels.composition: The dock from the water. The lights. Everyone. The chair. The steps. The pup at the dock's end. Two days left in the strip; the strip doesn't know, and looks like it always looks.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a lit dock on a gray day seen from the water with a family, a man on shack steps, an old lawn chair and a small dog at the dock's end, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Christmas on the dock, the same as always. 'Regular.'
